pages.title: Without the Nether
pages.text: Field stand-ins for blaze powder and magma cream. The Nether is severed in $(bold)Phase 5$().

pages.title: What They Replace
pages.text: $(bold)Sulfur Igniter$() for blaze powder, $(bold)Thermal Binder$() for magma cream, in:$(li)$(l:heating/thermal_core)Thermal Core$(/l)$(li)$(l:advanced/rocket_assembly)Rocket Engine$(/l)$(li)$(l:orsa_equipment/heavy_insulation)Heavy Gear$(/l)$(li)$(l:getting_started/hot_wings)Hot Wings$(/l)$(br2)They cost more than the originals.

pages.title: Blaze Powder Only
pages.text: No substitute for:$(li)$(l:advanced/core_upgrades)Core$(/l) temperature upgrades$(li)$(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l) fuel$(li)Heavy Gear repair$(br2)$(danger)Stock blaze powder before Phase 5.$()
Four sulfur and one coal. Mine sulfur in rupture calderas; see the $(l:advanced/fuel_processing_silo)Fuel Processing Silo$(/l).
Two sulfur and two $(l:getting_started/rimewood)Rimewood Resin$(/l): one from deep vents, one from cold groves.
